executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $163.29 per resident day (43.4% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.

Cost year 2025: the home recorded $12,039,898 in Connecticut Medicaid revenue (after its Medicaid contractual allowance) for 28,770 Medicaid days, $418.49 per Medicaid day. DSS's Medicaid daily rate was $427.76 for July 2024 to June 2025 and $420.85 for July 2025 to June 2026.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was 25.4% (Connecticut median 2.5%).
Cost year 2025: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $340,213, 5.1% of the $6,705,465 direct care cost.

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $986,915, $24.03 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $539,178 (54.6%), allocated fringe $104,436 (10.6%), non-wage costs $343,301 (34.8%). Raw food was $321,382 ($7.83 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.61).
Cost year 2025: housekeeping cost $467,247, $11.38 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.32). Wages $365,444 (78.2%), allocated fringe $70,785 (15.1%), non-wage costs $31,018 (6.6%).

Missing data: cost year 2021 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data); No related parties or management-service payees were read from the cost year 2025 report. That means none were read, not that none exist.

findings.statement: Cost year 2025: DSS's review changed 3 line(s) of the report, a net reduction of $47,344 in the costs DSS counts. Largest: Movable Equipment (page 22 line 7d), removed $32,186; Other Resident Care Supplies (page 20 line 5m), removed $13,591; Insurance Of Automobiles (page 27 line 14b), removed $1,567. Separately, the home itself removed $1,256,248 from the costs it claimed (for example bad debt, pharmacy or therapy that the daily rate does not cover). The data shows each change, not the reason.

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
